THE BOUNDED BANK MODEL (rc30): one CO2e-weighted stratum, supply = the UNEP consumption series (2021-23 interpolated, labelled), empty 2019 start (a lower-leaning bound), 0.5% assembly loss, 10%/yr operating loss bracketed [2.51, 5.89] Mt by the 5-15% IPCC range, no retirement inside the window, zero recovery per UNEP's no-licensing-system record. A screening configuration outside every reference total - between the CRT's near-zero and the potential-consumption ceiling, which is exactly where a bank answer must sit

THE SPECIES-RESOLVED BANK (rc46 Wave 4): per (species, application) strata from the UNDP RAC import table (2012-19), Comtrade HS-2022 (2022-24) and a typed geometric bridge for 2020-21, run through the fgases.py kernel with IPCC application loss defaults and blend GWPs priced at component shares. Supersedes the one-stratum bounded bank as the lane's answer; per-stratum detail in outputs/ippu_hfc_species_bank.csv
